'''Taisham''' is the first month in the [[Farede calendar]]. In most years, it is equivalent to the real world period from [[December]] [[December 22|22]] to [[January]] [[January 18|18]]. The first day of the year is sometimes known as [[First Day]] and it is the second day in the [[Feast of Lights]]. The feastday of [[High Chasaline]] also occurs during this month.
